notes: Pinned OCI SDK contract: Migration, MigrationSummary, CreateMigrationDetails, and UpdateMigrationDetails are all polymorphic over databaseCombination MYSQL and ORACLE. The published runtime requires spec.databaseCombination explicitly and builds the matching concrete create/update body type before OCI calls.

Pinned OCI SDK contract: CreateMigration returns a Migration body plus opc-work-request-id, while UpdateMigration and DeleteMigration surface only opc-work-request-id headers. The reviewed runtime therefore follows create, update, and delete with GetWorkRequest plus a concrete GetMigration reread before projecting status or confirming delete completion.

Pinned provider-facing shape: the CRUD family is CreateMigration, GetMigration, ListMigrations, UpdateMigration, and DeleteMigration, with list filters compartmentId, displayName, lifecycleState, and lifecycleDetails plus the service-local work-request status surface from GetWorkRequest.

Repo-authored bind-versus-create stays explicit: the reviewed runtime only attempts pre-create reuse when compartmentId, displayName, databaseCombination, type, sourceDatabaseConnectionId, and targetDatabaseConnectionId are all present, then narrows list candidates in memory by those stable fields through GetMigration rereads.

Repo-authored mutation policy stays explicit: only the UpdateMigrationDetails surface reconciles in place. compartmentId, assessmentId, and databaseCombination remain replacement-only drift, while includeObjects, excludeObjects, and bulkIncludeExcludeData are rejected because the live CRUD read model does not echo those helper inputs after create.

Repo-authored status projection and secret behavior stay explicit: the runtime projects the published Migration status read model from concrete GetMigration responses, preserves the shared async contract in status.async.current for work-request-backed flows, and has no Kubernetes secret side effects. hubDetails.restAdminCredentials.password is treated as write-only parity input because GetMigration redacts it after create.
